title.zh: 创建一个用于测试的设备分组
title.en: Create a device group for testing

descriptions.zh:
测试设备分组用于进行系统或应用版本的测试。创建测试设备分组后，在创建版本的测试时，选择该分组，会自动向分组中设备推送待测试版本的升级信息。

> 因为版本会关联机型，因此测试设备分组中的设备的机型需和待测试版本上配置的机型相同才可升级待测试版本，否则测试无效。
descriptions.en:
Test device groups are used to test system or application versions. After you create a test device group and select it when creating a version test, upgrade information for the version to be tested is automatically pushed to the devices in the group.

> Because versions are associated with device models, the device models in the test device group must match the device model configured for the version to be tested. Otherwise, the devices cannot be upgraded to the version and the test is invalid.
